Create an adult Mughal screened-courtyard private household reconstruction whose screened architecture, connected adult activity, portable objects, and prepared result are all testable in one photograph.

Create an adult Mughal screened-courtyard private household reconstruction during a monsoon evening preparation. The central adult coordinator's visible appearance follows the supplied reference: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, dark eyes, softly defined natural makeup, and front-facing facial proportions. Place this clearly adult coordinator and several clearly adult household participants inside a residential complex reached through an offset bent entrance that blocks a direct public sight line. Reveal a central courtyard through jali screening, with arcades and multiple small rooms continuing in depth. Connect one preparation chain across the frame: one adult carries folded textiles through the screened arcade, another tunes a stringed instrument, another lays out a game board and low cushions, and the coordinator checks the handoff and final arrangement. Show emptied carrying baskets, ordered textiles, occupied low seating, and the ready instrument as the immediate result. Use post-rain stone reflections, warm interior lamps, and a medium-wide deep composition that keeps entrance, screen, courtyard, rooms, adult actions, portable objects, and completion trace readable together.
